title: The Exact BSD Theorem Frontier
mathematical_role: State the theorem frontier as a labelled status matrix so established results retain their exact rank range and universal BSD obligations remain visibly open.
learning_objective: Separate Mordell-Weil, modularity, and analytic-rank-zero-or-one terrain from universal rank equality, Sha finiteness, and the complete leading-term formula.
literal_semantics: Mordell-Weil finite generation is established for elliptic curves over Q.
Modularity and the resulting analytic continuation are established for elliptic curves over Q.
Analytic rank zero or one gives the matching algebraic rank and finite Sha in the established low-rank terrain described by the documentary source.
Universal finiteness of Sha remains open.
The complete complex leading-term formula remains open in general.
nonliteral_semantics: The row order is pedagogical and is not a ranking of theorem strength.
The low-rank row is not extrapolated to higher rank.
Database evidence, parity, Selmer bounds, family averages, or p-adic results are not treated as universal BSD proofs.

notes: Candidate semantics are bounded by the existing documentary source; no new mathematical source is admitted by this visual operation.

renderer.version_or_environment: Python 3 standard library; deterministic SVG generator v1
reproducibility_notes: The generator uses no network, randomness, timestamps, or external data.
Repository tests compare generator output byte-for-byte with the committed SVG candidate.
Text uses ASCII mathematical notation where practical to reduce missing-glyph risk in supported render paths.

derivatives.role: immutable Batch-2 live successor; byte-identical to admitted candidate

accessibility.alt_text: A six-row BSD status matrix marks Mordell-Weil, modularity, and analytic rank zero or one as established terrain, and marks universal rank equality, universal finiteness of Sha, and the complete leading-term formula as open.
accessibility.long_description: The plate replaces an islands-and-ocean metaphor with a three-column matrix for claim, status, and scope. Three rows are labelled established with explicit scope; three universal obligations are labelled open. Text below prevents silent extrapolation from analytic rank zero or one to higher rank and excludes numerical and family evidence from universal proof status.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: The plate reproduces the documentary theorem/open boundary with the low-rank quantifier made explicit.

supersession_reason: Replace coastline metaphor with a scope-preserving theorem/open status matrix.
